---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature for Ovara
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement", "triage"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to a frustration, missing
capability, or new use case?

## Proposed Solution

Describe the desired behavior at a high level. API sketches are very helpful.

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is this one better?

## Use Cases

Concrete scenarios where this feature would be used.

## Impact

- [ ] Affects core decision pipeline
- [ ] Affects policy model
- [ ] Affects identity/trust model
- [ ] Adds new action surface
- [ ] Adds new microservice
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Test/quality improvement

## Willingness to Contribute

- [ ] I'm willing to submit a PR
- [ ] I'd like to discuss further first

## Additional Context

Links to related issues, RFCs, or external references.
